name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Hints.rank_condition_necessary
title: The rank condition of related-trapdoor LWE is necessary: a query containing the challenge row decodes it
statement: For any commutative ring, if u = c M and (M B) y = t, then <sigma (u B) + e, y> = sigma <c, t> + <e, y>; so a preimage oracle answering a query M whose row space contains the challenge direction u, on a target with <c, t> = 0, removes the secret.
